captures.text: Sam Reed agreed to ship the Snowflake migration by Friday.
Kafka consumer lag spiked at 14:02 on the ingest pipeline; investigating.
Stripe billing token expiry hotfix shipped Wednesday afternoon.
OpenAI embedding API outage incident review notes — root cause analysis attached.
Postgres autovacuum tuning notes from staging — bumped scale_factor to 0.05.
Alex Kim hiring panel feedback for the engineering manager role; 4 of 5 say strong hire.
Pat Lane will own the rollback plan for the Snowflake migration; new owner of the migration is Pat.
Latest decision: Stripe billing rollout timeline pushed to next Tuesday for safety.
Q3 budget review meeting on Snowflake; conclusion was to maintain current spend.
BigQuery cost comparison vs Snowflake — current BigQuery numbers $42k/mo, Snowflake $48k/mo.
Kafka follow-up meeting after the lag spike: pipeline health restored, monitoring tightened.
Pat Lane published the new on-call rotation policy and OnCall handoff procedure changes.
Weekend hike — Golden Gate trail conditions are dry; mileage 8.4.
